_comment: One entry per origin airport. Everything the daily Instagram pipeline needs to render and caption a board lives here, so adding city #11 is a config edit plus a token — no Python changes. `ig_enabled` gates the posting workflow: an origin with no live Instagram token stays false and is skipped by the matrix rather than failing the run.
_adding_a_city: 3. Add <CODE> to ORIGINS in scripts/build_index.py so the nightly index covers it.
4. Create the Instagram account, authorize it in the Meta app, add the token as the repo secret named in token_secret.
